title: guards.yaml
description:
Guard rules of the security module (modules/security/guards.yaml) and of a profile (profiles/

/guards.yaml). ADR-0020 shape, extended by ADR-0022. Patterns are JavaScript regular expressions.

guards.description: Destructive-command guards: pattern is matched against the shell command line.

secretFiles.description: Secret files: pattern is matched against the file name (last path segment) of a path the tool touches or a word of the command line.

secretValues.description: Secret values: pattern is matched against an answer value before the kit stores it in ~/.yaw (ADR-0043). Not used by the hooks.

secretAllow.description: File names that look like secret files but are not (e.g. .env.example); checked before secretFiles.

flags.description: Optional RegExp flags (secretValues rules use i).

reason.description: One sentence shown to the agent when it is blocked.
